description: Persistent memory for AI coding agents. Store decisions, lessons, error patterns, and task checkpoints, then retrieve them via semantic search or graph traversal. Features session briefings, memory consolidation, time-based reminders, encrypted profiles, and knowledge compaction. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, and any MCP-compatible client. #1 on LongMemEval benchmark (95.4%). Install: pip install omega-memory && omega setup

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: API key for authenticated OMEGA instances. Not required for the public demo server.

tools.name: omega_store
tools.description: Store a memory with optional type and metadata. Use when the user says 'remember this' or for programmatic capture (decisions, lessons, errors). Defaults to type 'memory' if event_type is omitted.

text.description: Alias for content — use either content or text

priority.description: Memory priority 1-5 (5=highest). Auto-set from event type if omitted.

entity_id.description: Scope this memory to an entity (e.g., 'acme'). Omit for unscoped.

agent_type.description: Agent type for sub-agent memory scoping (e.g., 'code-reviewer', 'test-runner').

event_type.description: Type: memory (default), session_summary, task_completion, error_pattern, lesson_learned, decision, user_preference

tools.name: omega_query
tools.description: Search memories — semantic (default) or exact phrase match. Use mode='phrase' for literal substring search (error messages, specific strings).

mode.description: Search mode: 'semantic' (default) for meaning-based search, 'phrase' for exact substring match

query.description: Search query (or exact phrase when mode='phrase')

entity_id.description: Filter results to a specific entity (e.g., 'acme'). Omit for all.

agent_type.description: Filter results to a specific agent type (e.g., 'code-reviewer'). Omit for all.

filter_tags.description: Hard filter — only return memories containing ALL specified tags (AND logic)

context_file.description: Current file being edited (boosts results relevant to this file's context)

context_tags.description: Current context tags like language, tools (boosts matching results)

case_sensitive.description: Case-sensitive search (only used with mode='phrase', default false)

temporal_range.description: Optional [start_iso, end_iso] date range filter. Auto-inferred from query text if omitted.

tools.name: omega_welcome
tools.description: Get a session welcome briefing with recent relevant memories and user profile.

tools.name: omega_profile
tools.description: Read or update the user profile. Returns the profile by default. If 'update' dict is provided, merges those fields into the profile and saves.

update.description: Profile fields to save (merged with existing). Omit to read profile.

tools.name: omega_delete_memory
tools.description: Delete a specific memory by its ID.

tools.name: omega_edit_memory
tools.description: Edit the content of a specific memory.

tools.name: omega_list_preferences
tools.description: List all stored user preferences.

tools.name: omega_health
tools.description: Detailed health check with memory usage, node counts, cache stats, warnings, and recommendations.

tools.name: omega_backup
tools.description: Export or import memories for backup/restore. Default mode is export.

filepath.description: File path for export or import

clear_existing.description: Clear current data before import (default true, only used in import mode)

tools.name: omega_lessons
tools.description: Retrieve cross-session or cross-project lessons learned, ranked by verification count and access frequency.

task.description: Optional task description for relevance filtering

agent_type.description: Filter lessons to a specific agent type (e.g., 'code-reviewer'). Omit for all.

cross_project.description: If true, search across all projects (default false)

exclude_project.description: Project path to exclude (only used with cross_project=true)

tools.name: omega_feedback
tools.description: Record feedback on a surfaced memory (helpful, unhelpful, outdated). Improves future surfacing quality.

memory_id.description: The memory node ID to rate

tools.name: omega_clear_session
tools.description: Clear all memories for a specific session. Use for cleanup after test sessions.

tools.name: omega_similar
tools.description: Find memories similar to a given memory. Use for discovering related context.

memory_id.description: The memory node ID to find similar memories for

tools.name: omega_timeline
tools.description: Show memory timeline grouped by day. Use to see what was captured recently.

days.description: Number of days to look back (default 7)

tools.name: omega_consolidate
tools.description: Run memory consolidation: prune stale low-value memories, cap session summaries, clean orphaned edges. Returns a report.

prune_days.description: Prune zero-access memories older than N days (default 30)

tools.name: omega_traverse
tools.description: Traverse the memory relationship graph from a starting memory. Shows all connected memories within N hops, useful for understanding context chains and discovering related knowledge clusters.

min_weight.description: Minimum edge weight to follow (0.0-1.0, default 0.0)

tools.name: omega_compact
tools.description: Compact related memories into consolidated knowledge nodes. Finds clusters of similar memories (same event type, high overlap) and creates summary nodes, marking originals as superseded. Reduces noise while preserving knowledge.

min_cluster_size.description: Minimum memories in a cluster to compact (default 3)

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum Jaccard similarity for clustering (0.0-1.0, default 0.6)

tools.name: omega_checkpoint
tools.description: Save a task checkpoint — captures current plan, progress, files touched, decisions, and key context. Use when: (1) context window is getting full, (2) completing a major milestone, (3) before starting a new session for an ongoing task. Checkpoints enable seamless session continuity.

plan.description: Current plan or goals — what you're trying to accomplish

progress.description: What's been completed, what's in progress, what remains

decisions.description: Key technical decisions made during this task

next_steps.description: What should be done next to continue this task

task_title.description: Brief title of the current task (e.g., 'Frontend redesign Phase 2')

key_context.description: Critical context needed to continue — patterns, variable names, API shapes, conventions

files_touched.description: Map of file paths to change summaries (e.g., {'src/App.tsx': 'Added routing'})

tools.name: omega_resume_task
tools.description: Resume a previously checkpointed task. Retrieves the latest checkpoint with full plan, progress, files, decisions, and next steps. Use at the start of a new session to continue where you left off.

limit.description: Number of checkpoints to retrieve (default 1 = latest only)

verbosity.description: How much context to return. 'full' = everything, 'summary' = plan + progress + next steps, 'minimal' = just next steps

task_title.description: Title of the task to resume (semantic search — doesn't need to be exact)

tools.name: omega_remind
tools.description: Set a time-based reminder. OMEGA will surface it when the time arrives (at session start or during active sessions). Use for 'remind me in 1 hour to...' requests.

context.description: Optional context to include with the reminder (e.g. relevant file paths, decisions)

tools.name: omega_remind_list
tools.description: List active reminders with their status and due times.

status.description: Filter by status (default: shows pending + fired)

tools.name: omega_remind_dismiss
tools.description: Dismiss a reminder by its ID. Use after acknowledging a reminder.

reminder_id.description: The reminder memory ID to dismiss

tools.name: omega_type_stats
tools.description: Get memory counts grouped by event type. Shows the composition of the memory store (how many decisions, lessons, errors, etc.).

tools.name: omega_session_stats
tools.description: Get memory counts grouped by session. Shows which sessions have contributed the most memories (top 20).

tools.name: omega_weekly_digest
tools.description: Get a weekly knowledge digest with stats, trends, and highlights. Shows new memories, session count, growth trends, type breakdown, and top topics.

days.description: Number of days to include in the digest (default 7)

tools.name: omega_protocol
tools.description: Get your coordination playbook — dynamically assembled operating instructions. Call at session start (step 2 after omega_welcome) or when you need protocol guidance. Returns context-sensitive rules based on project, peer activity, and learned lessons.

project.description: Current project path for context-sensitive protocol rules.

section.description: Specific section or group: 'memory', 'coordination', 'coordination_gate', 'teamwork', 'context', 'reminders', 'diagnostics', 'entity', 'heuristics', 'git', 'what_next'. Groups: 'solo', 'multi_agent', 'full', 'minimal'. Omit for auto-detect based on peer activity.

resources.name: Memory Status
resources.description: Current OMEGA memory system health, node counts, and storage stats.

prompts.name: session_start
prompts.description: Initialize an OMEGA-powered session with memory briefing and protocol loading.

prompts.name: remember
prompts.description: Store a decision, lesson, or preference in persistent memory.

arguments.name: content
arguments.description: What to remember (decision, lesson, preference, or error pattern).

arguments.name: type
arguments.description: Memory type: decision, lesson_learned, user_preference, error_pattern, or memory.
